title: Trust comes before automation in a developer flow
outcome: CI/CD is not only about shipping faster; it is about proving what was shipped.

verificationSteps: Test, lint ve build kapılarını çalıştır
Deploy edilen commit ile production çıktısını eşleştir

body:
A good developer flow helps people make decisions with less uncertainty, not merely type commands faster. That needs a small set of reliable checks.

Lint, tests, and a build are not enough by themselves. The team should also see which commit reached production, whether required variables exist, and whether the critical flow actually opens.

Automation earns its value by producing repeatable evidence, not just by being fast.
